claims.text: Santa Marina sits on the private peninsula of Ornos Bay with its own sandy beach.

findings.quote: Nestled on the private peninsula of Ornos Bay, with its own sandy beach

claims.text: The resort is designed like a traditional Mykonian village on a slope leading down to the sea.

findings.quote: Designed like a traditional Mykonian village perched on a slope leading down to the sea

claims.text: The private beach is a curve of golden sand in a quiet cove that slopes gradually into clear, shallow water.

findings.quote: Nestled in a quiet cove this curve of golden sand slopes gradually into crystal-clear, shallow waters.

claims.text: Ornos Bay is largely shielded from the strong Cycladic winds.

findings.quote: on calm and sought-after Ornos Bay, where you’re largely shielded from the almighty Cycladic winds

claims.text: The property is still owned by the local family that opened it.

findings.quote: The five-star property remains owned by the same local family that opened it four decades ago.

claims.text: The grounds still have the original windmill and a whitewashed chapel.

findings.quote: which still has its original windmill and whitewashed chapel

claims.text: Interiors are by Greek interior designer Silvina Macipe Krontiras, with light tones and natural island accents of wood and raffia.

findings.quote: Greek interior designer Silvina Macipe Krontiras. Interiors feature light tones with natural island accents of wood and raffia

claims.text: Suites have sea views from a balcony or terrace furnished with outdoor dining and sun loungers.

findings.quote: All feature seamless sea views from the balcony or terrace, furnished with outdoor dining for two and sunlounges.

claims.text: Ginkgo Spa has a traditional hammam, a sauna and a relaxation area.

findings.quote: as well as a traditional Hammam, a sauna, relaxation area and locker rooms for men and women.

claims.text: The infinity-edge Elais Pool has a nearby heated whirlpool and is suited to children.

findings.quote: the infinity-edge Elais Pool is expansive in size and features a nearby heated whirlpool. This pool is ideal for children

claims.text: The resort offers speedboats by the hour for exploring beaches and nearby islands.

findings.quote: Our rubber speedboats, available for an hourly rate, are ideal for exploring the beautiful beaches or nearby islands in comfort.

claims.text: Elais serves Greek cuisine with Mediterranean influences.

findings.quote: Elais by Santa Marina Mykonos, celebrates a Greek cuisine homecoming with Mediterranean influences.

claims.text: Santa Marina has its own private stretch of sandy beach on Ornos Bay.

findings.quote: Santa Marina is the only resort on Mykonos island with its own private stretch of sandy beach—and on calm and sought-after Ornos Bay

claims.text: The Oasis Pool is a seawater infinity pool with private cabanas set in the water.

findings.quote: infinity-edge Oasis Pool is unparalleled on Mykonos. This unique seawater pool features four private cabanas that appear immersed in the water.

claims.text: The resort's villas each include a fully equipped kitchen, a swimming pool and butler service.

findings.quote: our 12 exclusive villas at Santa Marina all include a fully equipped kitchen, swimming pool and butler service

claims.text: Ginkgo Spa treatments use natural skincare and thalassotherapy from ESPA and 111SKIN.

findings.quote: Treatments exclusively feature natural skincare and thalassotherapy from two renowned spa brands, ESPA and 111SKIN.

claims.text: Santa Marina is home to the world's first Buddha-Bar Beach.

findings.quote: including a cocktail bar and the world’s first ever Buddha-Bar Beach

claims.text: There are elevators and ramps to most areas, but the hillside grounds still have many stairs and hills.

findings.quote: There are elevators and ramps to most areas and guest rooms, but still many stairs and hills to navigate.

claims.text: The beachfront restaurant becomes a lively bar at night, so rooms near the spa are quieter.

findings.quote: For privacy and easy access to the gym and adults-only pool, request a room near the spa and away from the beachfront restaurant, which becomes a thrumming bar at night

claims.text: The Oasis Pool is exclusively for adults.

findings.quote: Exclusively for adults, the Oasis Pool embodies Santa Marina’s innately glamorous lifestyle.
